title: Nice Colors, Non-Slip Bottoms, Pouring Spouts
text:
Nice Colors, Non-Slip Bottoms, Pouring Spouts. This JOSEPH JOSEPH COMPACT NESTING MIXING BOWL SET WITH EGG SEPARATOR (40015; Built-In Egg Cracker, Pouring Spout; 4-Piece, Multicolored) is very colorful, and that's a big plus, because I love crayon colors. The non-slip bottoms are another big plus, because they're great for one-handed use. The built-in pouring spouts are nice.

However, they aren't really space-saving, because they only nest with each other in a three-bowl stack. I don't think they will nest with a second set of the same mixing bowls; and they definitely don't nest with any of my standard round mixing bowls. They're wide and shallow, with curved bottoms that aren't ideal for use with an electric hand mixer.

The fact that they're dishwasher safe but NOT microwave safe means they can't be used to cover things that I’m reheating in the microwave. You can't fudge the microwave thing, either, because of the metal egg-cracker strips added to each bowl.

In sum, these are nice mixing bowls, but they will probably see quite limited use in my kitchen. I have very little easily-accessed cabinet space available for mixing bowls, so I will probably get them out only when I’m baking and need to crack a lot of eggs.

features: Four-piece, nesting mixing bowl set with integrated egg yolk separator
Three mixing bowls with 1.5-quart, 2.5-quart and 4-quart capacities
Bowls feature non-slip bases and pouring spouts and integrated stainless-steel egg crackers
Egg yolk separator fits securely onto the side of all three bowls
description: The Joseph Nest Mix Four-Piece Mixing Bowl Set offers an innovative, space-saving design with functionality that cooks and bakers will appreciate. The set features three bowls with 1.5, 2.5 and 4 quart capacities--perfect for cooking and baking projects that require separation of ingredients. Each bowl is equipped with a stainless egg cracker for a clean break as well as a pouring spout for neat mixing. The bowls sit securely on countertops thanks to their non-slip bases. The set's fourth piece is a unique egg separator that can be secured to the side of all three bowls for effortless egg yolk and whites separation. Even better, the set nests together for convenient storage. The Nest Mix set is dishwasher safe. Please do not microwave.
